mapper.insert: insert into b_wuba_old_colliding_data_batch_no(batch_no, batch_type, push_time, api_code, data_source_type) values (#{batchNo}, #{batchType}, now(), #{apiCode}, #{dataSourceType})
mapper.select: select id, batch_no, api_code, data_source_type from b_wuba_old_colliding_data_batch_no where query_status = 0 and api_code = #{apiCode} and is_deleted = 0 order by id limit #{pageSize}
